fields.description: Kill switch. Clear this to stop every agent run and tool call at once.
fields.label: Global Enabled

fields.description: Maximum nesting depth for agent runs that start other runs.
fields.label: Max Depth

fields.description: Fallback token budget per agent per day when the agent sets none.
fields.label: Default Daily Token Budget

fields.description: Days a pending Agent Action waits for a decision. After that it expires and the agent has to propose again.
fields.label: Action Expiry (days)

fields.description: Skip agent triggers during data import and migration.
fields.label: Suppress on Import

fields.description: Fields extraction may never write on its own. The extracted value waits on the extraction record until a reviewer confirms it field by field.
fields.label: Sensitive Fields

fields.description: Pages of a document sent to the model. A longer document is refused.
fields.label: Max Extraction Pages

fields.description: Largest file extraction accepts, in MB.
fields.label: Max Extraction File Size (MB)

fields.description: Which engine parses PDFs on OpenRouter. native sends the file to the model itself; the OCR engines hand the model a text layer the reviewer never sees.
fields.label: PDF Parser Engine

fields.description: Extractions one user may start in a day.
fields.label: Extractions per User per Day
